subject: PrivDeploy commercial construct — exit protections, platform-fee treatment, and ops-fee options
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@vitruviameds.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PrivDeploy commercial construct — exit protections, platform-fee treatment, and ops-fee options

Hi Sarah — great speaking with you last week. Following up with a short note to outline the packaging options we discussed for a private (VPC / on-prem) deployment and to call out a few items we’ll need clarity on from procurement/legal at Vitruvia. Attached: PrivDeploy_Packaging_v1.pdf and SLA_matrix.xlsx.

Quick summary of the options we presented:
- Option A: Consumption + platform fee (monthly) — lower up-front, platform fee amortized monthly over committed term.
- Option B: Seat/operator license + one-time deployment fee — predictable node-based pricing with optional monthly ops retainer.
- Option C: Hybrid anchor (short-term commit) — reduced platform fee, higher per-token.

Three open items we need guidance on from you:
1) Exit protections: are you looking for a 90/180-day exit notice, or do you require a prorated migration credit / partial refund if you terminate at year 1?
2) Platform fee treatment: preference for capitalization (one-time invoice) vs monthly amortization? If amortized, over what window (6 / 12 / 24 months)?
3) Ops/on-call: do you want a flat retainer (predictable monthly) or pay-per-incident (lower baseline, higher spike exposure)? Retainer tiers and SLOs are in SLA_matrix.xlsx.

If it helps, we can propose a compromise: 12-month amortization for the platform fee with a 6-month exit protection (prorated credit for unused months) plus a 6-month implementation credit (20% of deployment fee) to offset onboarding effort.

Next steps: please loop procurement/legal and confirm which of the three open items they prefer; we’ll draft a narrow counterproposal and a redlineable term sheet. Happy to hop on another call this week if that’s easier.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments (stubs): PrivDeploy_Packaging_v1.pdf (10 pages), SLA_matrix.xlsx (2 sheets)

From: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@vitruviameds.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vitruviameds.com
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy commercial construct — exit protections, platform-fee treatment, and ops-fee options

Hi Irene — thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Quick answers from our side and a couple of follow-ups for your legal/procurement team:

- Exit protections: Procurement prefers a 90-day notice with a prorated credit for any prepaid platform fees; legal has asked about an explicit data-handback and escrow clause for model artifacts.
- Platform fee: Finance prefers monthly amortization over 12 months for budget smoothing.
- Ops/on-call: Our SRE lead prefers a retainer for predictable coverage but wants the option to convert to pay-per-incident after the pilot. Can you confirm if the retainer can be credited against future invoices if not consumed?

Cc’ing procurement so they see the options and can send any procurement-specific PO/process notes. Procurement: we’ll need a vendor form, SOC 2 evidence, and an outline of billing milestones for invoices.

Can you also confirm whether we can include a 6-month implementation credit in the term sheet (as discussed)? If so, we’d prefer that be applied to the first two invoices rather than as a lump credit.

Best —
Sarah
Senior PM, Platform Engineering\Vitruvia Medical Systems

---
Procurement (procurement@vitruviameds.com) added: "Procurement: please send vendor intake and any standard contract templates you need us to fill out."

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 12:20:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: PrivDeploy commercial construct — pricing posture and suggested counter

Irene / Ben — summarizing our internal recommended posture for negotiation with Vitruvia based on Sarah’s responses. Draft counter attached (privdeploy_counterproposal.xlsx).

Key recommended concessions (balanced to protect ARR while addressing Vitruvia’s asks):
- Platform fee: amortize over 12 months (aligns with Finance). Invoice upfront but show amortization schedule in the commercial appendix; include prorated refund on early termination (90-day notice required).
- Implementation credit: 20% of one-time deployment fee, applied as credit across first two monthly invoices (helps procurement budget profile).
- Exit protections: 90-day notice + data-handback clause; propose 30-day knowledge-transfer window (redwood-led).
- Ops/support: offer two retainer tiers (Silver = $12k/mo, 4-hr response; Gold = $25k/mo, 1-hr response). Allow conversion to pay-per-incident after pilot with a 30-day notice; any unused retainer hours in the first 6 months are credited against support invoices.
- License model: recommend operator-seat bundling for first year with a conversion clause to consumption pricing at renewal if usage patterns are below threshold.

Risks to call out: the amortized platform fee creates a modest cashflow lag; we should propose amortization only when a 12-month minimum commit is accepted. For shorter pilots, keep platform fee as upfront.

Proposed next steps: send the counterproposal + redlineable term sheet and request a procurement checklist from Vitruvia. If procurement asks for additional credits, we can offer a time-limited pilot discount rather than expanding the implementation credit.

Marissa
Senior Director, Commercial\Redwood Inference

Attachments (stub): privdeploy_counterproposal.xlsx (pricing worksheets)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@vitruviameds.com>, procurement@vitruviameds.com
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jun 2025 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PrivDeploy commercial construct — exit protections, platform-fee treatment, and ops-fee options

Sarah / Vitruvia procurement — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is a narrow counter and a redlineable term sheet (redlines_privdeploy_terms.docx). High level:

- We accept monthly amortization of the platform fee over 12 months for a 12-month minimum commitment. We will invoice the full platform fee at contract signing and apply an amortization schedule to your internal accounting; early termination within year 1 triggers a prorated refund for remaining amortized months after a 90-day notice window.
- Implementation credit: 20% of deployment fee, applied across the first two invoices per your preference.
- Support: offering Silver and Gold retainers as Marissa outlined. For pilots shorter than 90 days, support must be pay-per-incident or a one-time pilot retainer; we can convert post-pilot with 30 days’ notice.
- Data handback & escrow: we will include a standard data-handback appendix and can discuss escrow for model artifacts if legal requires it — please indicate the scope (models, weights, or derived artifacts).
